quotes.excerpt: I think LeBron is a businessman.
quotes.quote: I think LeBron is a businessman. I think we all can look at it and say, though it's a luxury to have him, you can't spend that much money on him if you want to make your team good enough to beat who's at the top. People got a pretty calmed-out team top to bottom, but they got youth. You can't sit here and depend on Bron. I think it was more a youth thing, and LeBron actually saying, if I want to give myself a chance to win, I got two years left. I don't need no money. Might as well put the best team together, put the best product together, and I go out with a bang.

So when I, when I, when I was on the podcast, they was under the comments saying like, Shumpert, if they win the next game, like you got to walk seven five. Like you ain't going to walk seven five. Then they like, man, if they don't win this next game, you got to wear your jersey and sub in. I'm like, I'll wear my jersey, but I was just trolling. Right.
